questions.prompt: Which of these books did Roald Dahl write?
questions.fact: The BFG speaks his own language, gobblefunk, which Dahl made up.

questions.prompt: Which of these currencies are used in Asia?
questions.fact: The baht began as a weight for silver, and in Thailand gold is still sold by the baht.

questions.prompt: How many hours a day does a koala sleep?
questions.fact: Around 20. Gum leaves give it very little energy, so it saves what it can.

questions.prompt: How tall is the Statue of Liberty from the ground to the tip of the torch, in metres?
questions.fact: About 93 m with its pedestal. The copper skin is thinner than two coins stacked together.

questions.prompt: What is the largest organ of the human body?
questions.fact: An adult's skin weighs around four kilograms.

questions.prompt: Which Pixar film is set mostly in Paris?
questions.hint: It is about a rat who wants to be a chef.
questions.fact: Pixar's team ate at top Paris restaurants and took a cooking class to get the kitchen scenes right.
